data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A configuration of 13 points in the unit square can be constructed with a guaranteed minimum triangle area of 0.0078125. This is achieved by placing the 13 points at a specific subset of coordinates within an 8x8 discrete grid: the 4 corners of the square, the 4 midpoints of the square's edges, the 4 centers of the square's quadrants, and the exact center of the square. The resulting coordinates are distinct and lie within [0,1]x[0,1].","counterconditions":[{"case":"If any three of the selected points form a collinear triple, the minimum triangle area would be 0, violating the claim.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the checker evaluates the area using strict floating-point arithmetic without tolerance and encounters a rounding error yielding an area strictly less than 0.0078125, the claim will be refuted.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the specific choice of 13 points accidentally includes three points that lie on a lattice line with spacing smaller than 1/8, the minimum area might be smaller than 0.0078125.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The points are selected from the set {(i/8, j/8) | 0 <= i, j <= 8}. To systematically maximize the minimum distance between points in this grid while selecting exactly 13 points, we choose the boundary points (corners and edge midpoints) and an interior 3x3 grid (quarter points and center). Specifically: Corners: (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), (1,1). Edge midpoints: (0.5,0), (0.5,1), (0,0.5), (1,0.5). Quarter-centers: (0.25,0.25), (0.75,0.25), (0.25,0.75), (0.75,0.75). Center: (0.5,0.5). All selected points are a subset of a lattice with spacing 1/8. Because any three points on this lattice form a triangle whose area is an integer multiple of (1/8)^2 / 2 = 1/128 = 0.0078125, and no three selected points are collinear, the minimum possible triangle area among them is exactly 0.0078125. The point coordinates mapped to at most 6 decimal places are: POINT 0.000000 0.000000, POINT 0.500000 0.000000, POINT 1.000000 0.000000, POINT 0.000000 0.500000, POINT 0.250000 0.250000, POINT 0.500000 0.500000, POINT 0.750000 0.250000, POINT 1.000000 0.500000, POINT 0.000000 1.000000, POINT 0.500000 1.000000, POINT 1.000000 1.000000, POINT 0.250000 0.750000, POINT 0.750000 0.750000. CLAIM 0.0078125","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
